newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Kookmin's GDR issue due in late Sept.
newsitem.headline: Kookmin's GDR issue due in late Sept.

text.p: Kookmin Bank's proposed issue of $300 million worth of global depositary receipts (GDRs) is expected to be made late this month for payment around September 23, traders on the Seoul won-dollar market said on Wednesday.
"There is no change in our plan to issue within this month. Payment deadline is expected to be around September 23," a source at lead-manager Ssangyong Securities told Reuters.
Kookmin Bank officials declined to confirm the talk, saying details would be finalised after road shows abroad.
The commercial bank has been approved by the Seoul government to issue the receipts during the third quarter.
